_comment: Scorer's codes for indoor cricket score sheets. Values confirmed against real Spawtz sheets: every row and over total adds up with these rules. Superscript digits (², ³ ...) are treated as normal digits.
_dismissals: Wicket codes. Spawtz writes stumped as 's'; 'st' is accepted too. In their innings, a wicket is a bowling clip when I bowled the over and a fielding clip otherwise (the sheet has no fielder names). Checked against fixture 53303: every over's wicket codes match its footer.
_extras_suffix: A number after an extra (e.g. nb²) is extra runs scored off that delivery, added to the extra's own runs.
_batter_total: On Spawtz sheets a batter's row total includes the extras written in their row, so the check does the same.
